body: Use case: stylized-concept. NEW original Firethorn Turbo 2005 compact FOUR DOOR turbo sports sedan sprite sheet for 2994 salvage racing game. Reference only worn handpainted style and eight-view layout, do NOT copy its two-door coupe. Short rounded nose, compact tall cabin with TWO separate doors and TWO door handles on EACH side, rounded hood with small functional scoop, separate short trunk with a tall simple rear wing. Original rounded triangular front lights and vertical rounded rectangular rear lamps, no manufacturer trade dress. Weathered deep brick red paint, faded teal repair panels, charcoal bumpers. Exactly eight isolated views 4columns by2rows, wide3:1 transparent canvas: top front, frontquarter noseLEFT, fullside noseLEFT, rearquarter noseRIGHT; bottom rear, rearquarter noseLEFT, fullside noseRIGHT, frontquarter noseRIGHT. Same four-door sedan all views. NO tires, rims or wheels: fully transparent wheel-arch openings open through bottom, no black backing. Shared game tires added later. No logos, text, ground, shadows or scenery; generous margins, no overlap/crop. Genuine alpha transparency outside silhouettes, clean edges.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. NEW original Firethorn Turbo 2005 four-door sport sedan LHD dashboard overlay for2994 salvage game. Reference only worn painterly texture and transparent overlay construction, create DIFFERENT curved charcoal dashboard with aged teal trim and brick red repairs, oval side vents, small central rectangular vents, compact central radio and three plain climate knobs. Large completely BLANK opaque black oval instrument binnacle on LEFT x200..800 y460..690 of1983x793canvas; runtime draws gauges, no painted dials/numbers. Wide2.5:1canvas. Dashboard occupies lower half, straight-on driver camera; clean native transparent alpha.
